purpose: Project the complete already-frozen blind rule set back onto anonymous source objects without reopening provenance, so co-occurring relational programs can be studied at source level without retaining the full physical event ledger.

inputContract.rules: all train-derived rules from the immutable blind discovery packet, in frozen blind-rank order
inputContract.sourceUniverse: all sourceGroupIds from the sealed blind compiler input
inputContract.physicalEvidence: the exact append-only v7 physical event ledger whose chunk hashes and Merkle root are recorded in compiler custody

projectionContract.contextMultiplicity: for a center with context-arm multiplicity c and resolved degree d, contextCount += c * (d - 1)
projectionContract.sparseRowRule: emit one anonymous source-rule row iff contextCount > 0
projectionContract.exactAggregateEquivalenceGate: for every frozen rule and each train/holdout/control lane, summing anonymous source-rule context and predicted-outcome counts must exactly equal the v7 observed iteration=-1 grammar statistics

rejoinMayAttach: source context already present in custody

acceptanceCorpus: same machine-enumerated 714-source Cleveland / Bavarian State Library / Library of Congress corpus used by blind-discovery v1; widening source diversity is a later experiment after this capability passes
